summary: Frontend-only validation completed for 3D envelope interaction, accessibility controls, reduced-motion, mobile/desktop layout, continuation flow, and forced non-WebGL fallback on public preview URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Card upper edge appears partially tucked under flap hinge in final open state; possible layering/depth ordering issue versus requested front-slide reveal.

integration_issues.issue: Console emits React invalid DOM property warning: `transform-origin` should be `transformOrigin`.

issues: Fallback flap inscription readability is weaker than primary 3D state (text near flap fold appears partially constrained).

action_items: Fix flap/card layering so inner card top clearly sits in front at final open state per request.
Locate and fix JSX prop using `transform-origin` to remove runtime React warning.
Polish non-WebGL fallback flap text layout for clearer full inscription readability.
critical_code_review_comments: Envelope scene transitions and keyboard focus handling are robust (Enter/Space supported, focus moves to continue CTA).
Public URL renders non-blank canvas with measurable pixel variation across closed→mid→open states (animation verified).
Avoid relying on hidden SR-only text as proof of visual inscription; visual state should remain primary acceptance criterion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. No horizontal overflow in tested states. Keyboard open and reduced-motion path pass. Forced no-WebGL fallback allows open + continue. Continue reveals invitation sections and venue link remains correct. Review 3D final-layering and transform-origin warning next.
rca of the issue: Potential flap/card overlap likely comes from 3D transform/depth sequencing in createEnvelopeScene/EnvelopeCanvas animation timing: flap rotates to -PI while card lifts to a fixed Y, leaving card top visually intersecting/behind flap edge at final frame. React warning RCA: one component still uses kebab-case `transform-origin` instead of camelCase `transformOrigin` in JSX style/prop path. Mitigation: tune card Z/Y lift and/or flap pivot depth at end state; correct DOM prop casing.
